Hi all — investigated the ledger: auto-collect attempted once on 2026-11-08 18:04 UTC and the gateway returned a hard decline. No funds were captured. System automatically generated the prorated VAT line because the add-on effective date (2026-11-11) falls in the billing period.

Options we can execute (choose one):
- Issue a credit note for the VAT line only (recommended for EU VAT reconciliation). This creates a credit that offsets VAT on the account and we can mark the credit as applied to the next invoice.
- Issue a full refund for the prorated add-on (slower, requires reversing a capture — not applicable here since capture failed).
- Leave invoice as-is and pause auto-collect until AP confirms new payment method.

Proposed action from Redwood: create a VAT-credit note (detailed line item) and publish an amended invoice that shows the VAT reversal. I’ve drafted a credit note PDF (CreditNoteDraft-ACME-20261109.pdf) — please review. If Acme wants the credit applied to the next invoice, we can do that and disable automatic retries for 7 days while you update the payment method.

Next steps:
- Claudia: confirm you want the credit note (yes/no) and whether to apply to next invoice or refund to card.
- Marcus/Naomi: if approved, I’ll issue the credit note and publish an amended invoice (we can send a DocuSign link for acceptance if required).
